inclusion_rule: Neural signal speech or tone decoding studies that shrink the recording set for the main experiment by ranking channels with trained-model attention weights (or similar attribution) and keeping a top subset, and that report a full-versus-reduced accuracy comparison. Boundary: hardware-only channel counts, exhaustive or greedy selection without attention, EMG-only electrode subsets and papers with no full-versus-reduced comparison are excluded; selecting channels with data spanning test folds or subjects is included but flagged; versions of one study count once.
